summary_1line: Narada asks Asita-Devala about creation and dissolution; the sage explains the universe through five elements, time, senses, mind, and the hierarchy leading to the Soul.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Asita-Devala sits calmly as Narada approaches and questions him about the origin and end of the universe.
A symbolic vision of the five elements—earth, water, fire, wind, and space—radiating power while Time stands among them shaping creation.
A meditative figure with senses, mind, and intellect layered upward toward a luminous inner Soul.
